evidence.quoted_text: report = dispatch(config, role, current, wt, attempt_dir)
evidence.reason: The blackout guard at line 457 runs before `retain`, worktree reset/clean/create, and progress recording. If that preparation crosses a blackout boundary, line 478 still dispatches a paid attempt with no recheck, so an attempt that no longer fits can launch during the blackout. This is a stale-check implementation bug in the existing defer behavior, not a new requirement; the smallest fix is to recheck immediately before recording/dispatching the paid launch and defer without setting `dispatch_pending`.
